text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Urk... I feel like my body fat<n>percentage's gone up a
lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you have been snacking in your<n>room after
getting back from your<n>part-time jobs, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I can't help getting hungry when I<n>handle food
at work...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I know how that feels, but<n>don't forget to
work up a sweat after<n>you chow down.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Ryan, what's your body<n>fat
percentage?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You wanna see? I'll measure myself<n>right now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's a crazy number. You're pure<n>muscle...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's it! I'm going to get fit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I can help you out with that!<n>Let's start with a
hundred squats!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...No, if I want to bulk up, then a<n>workout like that is
just what I need!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Ryan! I'm going to tone<n>up for sure!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With Mejiro Ryan's help, Ines Fujin<n>maintains a
healthy physique.
